starting-off.speaker: Veos
starting-off.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Could you give me some advice on Kourend?
Have you got any quests for me?

steps.player: Have you got any quests for me?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: As a matter of fact, [player name], I do...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I have a client from the mainland who's interested in learning a bit more about Kourend. They've asked me to gather some information on the five cities for them.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I was just going to do it myself, but as you're quite new around here, this might be a good opportunity for you to get to know the kingdom a bit better.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: So what do you say?

steps.prompt: Start the Client of Kourend quest?

steps.player: Sounds interesting! How can I help?

steps.text: Veos hands you an enchanted scroll.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Take this scroll.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: My client is interested in the hierarchy and general social organisation of Great Kourend. Especially when it comes to how it differs from the mainland.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: That scroll is special. When written on with a particular type of quill, my client will see what you're writing without anything being seen on the scroll itself.

steps.player: Wait, wait! I'm not spying for somebody am I?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Not exactly... My client simply wishes to keep their 'knowledge gathering' on the down low.

steps.player: That seems fair. Who should I speak to in order to find out more about the cities?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: There's many a man and woman who could give you the information you need, but general store owners in each city will likely be your best bet.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: They should know enough about their cities, and always seem up for a chat.

steps.player: Good call. What about this special quill you mentioned?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Simply touching a normal feather onto the paper should synchronise their magical ability to work together. You don't need any ink.

steps.player: Right, I'll return to you when I have the information your client needs.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: See you soon.

steps.player: I'm busy at the moment, actually. Not now.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Very well. Do come back if you wish to help out my client.

starting-off-using-a-feather-on-enchante.text: You attune the feather to the enchanted scroll, creating an enchanted quill.
You already have an Enchanted quill in your backpack. There's no need to make another.
You can't create another quill... by using the quill on the scroll.

starting-off-talking-to-veos-again.speaker: Veos
starting-off-talking-to-veos-again.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Could you tell me more about Kourend?

steps.player: Let's talk about your client...

options.text: What am I meant to be doing, again?

steps.player: What am I meant to be doing, again?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: My client is interested in the hierarchy and general social organisation of Great Kourend. Especially when it comes to how it differs from the mainland.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: That scroll I given to you is special. When written on with a particular type of quill, my client will see what you're writing without anything being seen on the scroll itself.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Speak to the general store owners of each city. They should have enough knowledge of their own city to pry out of them what you need, and they always seem up for a chat.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Remember: simply use a feather on the scroll to attune it as a quill.

steps.player: Thanks, Veos!

options.text: I've lost something you've given me.

steps.player: I've lost something you've given me.

steps.text: If the player has lost/banked the scroll but doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I'll be happy to provide you with another scroll, [player name], though I'm afraid you don't seem to have any room in your backpack! Return to me when you have.
If the player has lost/banked the scroll:
Veos hands you back an enchanted scroll.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Worry not, [player name], I have many of those scrolls. Luckily, due to the way it works, you haven't lost any information on it!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Remember, if you still need to create a quill, simply attune a feather by using it on the scroll.

steps.player: Thanks, Veos!

steps.text: If the player has the scroll in their backpack:

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: You already have your scroll, [player name], I can literally see it peeking out of your backpack...

regath-the-arceuus-general-store-owner.speaker: Regath
regath-the-arceuus-general-store-owner.text: What do you require, traveller? I deal in many things.

options.text: Can I ask you about Arceuus?

steps.player: Can I ask you about Arceuus?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: This city holds knowledge many would deem unsafe to share. Why should I be so trusting to you?

steps.player: Well, I'm a...
Uhm...
A journalist! Yes, a journalist from the mainland. I want to let the wider world know of how this incredible city works.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Someone willing to share knowledge of our great city to many others?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Very well, then. The rest of the world could certainly do with learning about our great library.
If the player does not have an enchanted quill:
You require the Enchanted Scroll Veos gave you and an Enchanted Quill before gathering information from the shopkeepers.

steps.player: I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! I'll be back in a tick!

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: You're not a very good journalist if you forget your equipment. Very well, then. I'll await your return.
If the player has an enchanted quill:

options.text: So what exactly is it the people Arceuus bring to Great Kourend?

steps.player: So what exactly is it the people Arceuus bring to Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Arceuus is filled with literary and magical scholars. Lead by the great Trobin Arceuus. As a leader, he assists in pushing the limit of our knowledge surrounding magical abilities, souls and the crafting of runic energy.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: He cares not for petty control, focusing instead on the expansion of knowledge within Great Kourend.

options.text: What is there to do in Arceuus?

steps.player: What is there to do in Arceuus?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Our library is something to behold, but the millennia of knowledge found there; runic, magical and religious, are but small findings compared to the power of the Dark Altar.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Through its power, we have great knowledge on life and death. This knowledge could be yours as well.

steps.player: ARGH!

steps.text: Your quill and scroll glow, causing a seething pain to run through your hand and arm.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: What is the matter, journalist?

steps.player: I... I don't know.
I must have caught my finger with the quill. Apologies; please continue.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Very well. As mentioned, rewards on offer within our city are priceless. The sharing of our magical research is but child's play compared to the knowledge of Blood and Soul runecrafting.
If Regath was not the last general store owner you talked to:
You jot down all of the information Regath had to say about Arceuus.
If Regath was the last general store owner you talked to:
As you jot down the final information on Arceuus, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'

steps.player: Thanks for your help!

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: You're welcome. Spread the word of this great city with the new knowledge you have gained, and perhaps be more careful with how you hold your scroll in the future...

horace-the-hosidius-general-store-owner.speaker: Horace
horace-the-hosidius-general-store-owner.text: Hello, I'm Horace. Welcome to my shop. Would you like to buy or sell something?

options.text: Can I ask you about Hosidius?

steps.player: Can I ask you about Hosidius?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Well, well my friend! I've lived in this great and glorious city all of my life. I'd be happy to share with you anything you'd like to know!
If the player does not have an enchanted quill:
You require the Enchanted Scroll Veos gave you and an Enchanted Quill before gathering information from the shopkeepers.

steps.player: Oh dear, I'm sorry. I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! Can you hold that thought?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Absolutely. I'm always up for a chat with any of my new patrons!
If the player has an enchanted quill:

options.text: What is it that Hosidius provides for Great Kourend?

steps.player: What is it that Hosidius provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Hosidius is filled with keen and skilled farmers alike! Lead by the incredibly efficient Kandur Hosidius, his intelligent resourcefulness ensures optimal agricultural production.

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Our fields stretch as far as the eye can see. With incredible teamwork and group efforts, the ability to provide Great Kourend's people with food and herbal supplies is quite literally the fruits of our labour.

options.text: What is there to do in Hosidius?

steps.player: What is there to do in Hosidius?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Our personal kitchens and farming patches are lovely. That being said, the real gems of Hosidius are the vinery and Tithe farm. Both are world class!
If Horace was not the last general store owner you talked to:
You jot down all of the information Horace had to say about Hosidius.
If Horace was the last general store owner you talked to:
As you jot down the final information on Hosidius, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'

steps.player: Thanks for your help, Horace!

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Anytime, friend! Feel free to pop along if you ever need any wares!

options.text: Can I ask you about Lovakengj?

steps.player: Can I ask you about Lovakengj?

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Why I'd be happy to have a chat! I do enjoy talking about this great city of ours.
If the player does not have an enchanted quill:
You require the Enchanted Scroll Veos gave you and an Enchanted Quill before gathering information from the shopkeepers.

steps.player: Oh dear, excuse me, I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! I'll be back in a tick!

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Very well, I look forward to chatting with you!
If the player has an enchanted quill:

options.text: What is it that Lovakengj provides for Great Kourend?

steps.player: What is it that Lovakengj provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Lovakengj is filled with incredibly skilled blacksmiths. Under the leadership of Vulcana Lovakengj, our intelligent material saving skills make us the finest blacksmiths in the land.

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Armours, weaponry, tools and structures - our city supplies Kourend with all of these to the finest standards known to Dwarf and Human alike.

options.text: What is there to do in Lovakenj?

steps.player: What is there to do in Lovakenj?

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Well creating dynamite and mining in the sulphur mine isn't a pretty job, but someone has to do it!

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: We also make the armour worn by the very soldiers of the Shayzien Army here, not to mention the Blast Mine.

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: The rewards able to be reaped in our city are nothing to be scoffed at!
If Munty was the last general store owner you talked to:
You jot down all of the information Munty had to say about Lovakengj.
If Munty was the last general store owner you talked to:
As you jot down the final information on Lovakengj, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'

steps.player: Thanks for your help!

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Anytime! Come back soon!

leenz-the-port-piscarilius-general-store.speaker: Leenz
leenz-the-port-piscarilius-general-store.text: A great adventurer, from afar? How may I help with my repertoire?

options.text: I don't need anything right now.
Can I ask you about Port Piscarilius?

steps.player: Can I ask you about Port Piscarilius?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: If it's Piscarilius information you seek, it's in my brain that you must peek!
If the player does not have an enchanted quill:
You require the Enchanted Scroll Veos gave you and an Enchanted Quill before gathering information from the shopkeepers.

steps.player: I'm sorry, I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! Can you hold that rhyme?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: If there's one thing, that I do best, it's waiting patiently, for my guests!
If the player has an enchanted quill:

options.text: What is it that Port Piscarilius provides for Kourend?

steps.player: You're certainly a chirpy woman! What is it that Port Piscarilius provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Within Port Piscarilius, you'll find, great fisherman, traders, pirates and I. All lead, by our ruthless leader, Shauna Piscarilius, none yet to supersede her.

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: No surprise if you meet her, her tactics are ruthless. Her demeanour renders, all pirates toothless.

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Our great shore and trading, have treasures to be found, providing export and fish, in quantities abound.

options.text: What is there to do in Port Piscarilius?

steps.player: What is there to do in Port Piscarilius?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Our shore is brimming, with gold from the sea, the most loyal of our people, are handed the key. We'll let you stand on our shores and collect, the great anglerfish; other only... covet?
If Leenz was not the last general store owner you talked to:
You jot down all of the information Leenz had to say about Port Piscarilius... With slightly less poetry.
If Leenz was the last general store owner you talked to:
As you jot down the final information on Port Piscarilius, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'

steps.player: Hang on a second... that last one didn't rhyme too well!

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Listen here pal, you don't mess with people in Port Piscarilius. Do you want happy rhyming Leenz, or angry, gruff and pain-inflicting Leenz?

steps.player: Happy rhyming Leenz, please! Thanks for your help!

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Anytime, my adventuring friend, enjoy your time in Great Kourend!

jennifer-the-shayzien-general-store-owne.speaker: Jennifer
jennifer-the-shayzien-general-store-owne.text: What're yer looking for, me luv'?

options.text: I don't need anything right now.
Can I ask you about Shayzien?

steps.player: Can I ask you about Shayzien?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Well I could give you some info if that's all yer wantin'. Gets lonely in 'ere while me mates are out there fightin' the good war!
If the player does not have an enchanted quill:
You require the Enchanted Scroll Veos gave you and an Enchanted Quill before gathering information from the shopkeepers.

steps.player: Apologies, I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Well ye canne remember everything I 'ave to say about this wee 'ouse without that, can you? Come back when yer 'ead's not all fried!
If the player has an enchanted quill:

options.text: What is it that Shayzien provides for Great Kourend?

steps.player: What is it that Shayzien provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Phwoar, what don' we do? This place is filled with officers and the like. Lead by our rig'rous leader Shiro Shayzien, 'e ensures ultimate justice and safety for the entirety of Great Kourend.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Our soldiers fight off the constant threat of the lizardman, while our 'ighly trained medics 'eal them from battle. Strict in combat trainin' and discipline. Law, order and defence. These are the words we live by!

options.text: What is there to do in Shayzien?

steps.player: What is there to do in Shayzien?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: It ain't all pretty 'ere, but if you 'elp our soldiers and tackle some organised crime... you'll soon find that the spoils o' war are grand.
If Jennifer was not the last general store owner you talked to:
You jot down all of the information Jennifer had to say about Shayzien.
If Jennifer was the last general store owner you talked to:
As you jot down the final information on Shayzien, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'

steps.player: Thanks for your help!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: That's alright petal, you go'un and have fun.

returning-to-veos.speaker: Veos
returning-to-veos.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Could you tell me more about Kourend?

steps.player: Let's talk about your client...
I have gathered information from all of the cities.
I could hear a voice, Veos... in my head! As if it whispered in my ear to return to you!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Yes, I heard it too... they mentioned that your task was complete.
If the player still has the enchanted scroll and quill:

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Let me take those items off your hands.
Veos removes the items he gave you from your backpack.

steps.player: That reminds me, Veos! I didn't sign up to this! I wasn't told that my mind would be entered. And what about the possibility of severely damaging my hand?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: If it makes you feel any better, my client sends their apologies. It wasn't intentional. Needless to say, something you said provoked emotion...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Namely...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: The Dark Altar...

steps.player: If I knew mentioning the Dark Altar would upset them so much, I'd have not written that bit of information down!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Well that's just the thing, [player name]. My client is pleased you found such information. Tell me... Would you be willing to do one last thing for them?

steps.player: Well, I don't necessarily believe I have much of a choice!
What should I do now?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I'm certainly glad you're able to assist once again.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: My client will be most pleased.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: My client requires... another simple task. They assure me that it will be the last. Take this orb. You must activate it beside the Dark Altar, north of Arceuus.
Player receives a mysterious orb.

steps.player: Can I ask why I would do that?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: It's best you don't.

steps.player: Well, can't argue with that! I'll return when I'm done!

returning-to-veos-talking-to-veos-again-.speaker: Veos
returning-to-veos-talking-to-veos-again-.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Could you tell me more about Kourend?

steps.player: Let's talk about your client...

options.text: So what exactly is it your client now wants me to do?

steps.player: So what exactly is it your client now wants me to do?

steps.text: If the player has lost the mysterious orb:
Veos hands you an enchanted orb.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Take this orb.
(Same as above from "My client requires...")

options.text: I've lost something you've given me.

steps.player: I've lost something you've given me.

steps.text: If the player has the orb in their backpack:

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: You already have the orb, [player name], I can literally see it peeking out of your backpack...
If the player has lost/banked the orb but doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I'll be happy to provide you with another orb, [player name], though I'm afraid you don't seem to have any room in your backpack! Return to me when you have room.
If the player has lost/banked the orb:
Veos hands you another mysterious orb.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Please be more careful, [player name]. Remember to return to me when you have used the orb in the area.

steps.player: Thanks, Veos!
Goodbye.

activating-the-orb-using-the-activate-op.text: The orb shatters after being held in the air.
You hear a whisper in your ear. 'Return... to Veos. My thanks...'

activating-the-orb-using-the-activate-op.player: I really wish I would be warned about these things earlier...

activating-the-orb-trying-to-activate-th.text: The orb doesn't seem to respond here. Try moving closer to the Dark Altar.

finishing-up.speaker: Veos
finishing-up.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Could you tell me more about Kourend?

steps.player: Veos, enough is enough! I've suffered through enough. Exploding orbs and burning quills...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: [player name]? What are you talking about?

steps.player: You know darn well what I'm talking about!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: [player name], I haven't spoken with you since bringing you to Kourend, I have no idea what you're on ab--

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: ARGH!

steps.player: Veos, this isn't funny anymore... Are you alright? I did all that your client asked of me...

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: Indeed you have.

steps.player: Uhm... Veos?

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: You have done well. For that, you have my thanks.

steps.player: Who are you? What have you done with Veos?

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: You need not fear for him. I will ensure no harm comes his way.

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: As for who I am... Well, that is of no importance.

steps.player: I have a right to know!

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: Knowledge can be a curse. Sometimes, it is better to remain unaware.

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: Now, time to release this mind back to consciousness... Don't worry, I'll make sure he rewards you. After all, you've been very useful to me...
Congratulations! Quest complete!
